name: R5-10 NAFNet blur-eligibility recalibration — pre-registered DEV selection protocol
written: 2026-10-08, before any R5-10 DEV result was inspected (DEV collection running)

baseline.note: blur_max was inherited from the A4 rwgate (p5-rwgate-1.0.0 blur_scan_best, A4 benefit on p4dev+r5gap); it was never calibrated for NAFNet.

dev_data: archive val split (19,290 pairs), face_chip + full_image, R5-8 path; R5-8-eligible outcomes from r5_8/corpus + local_features
archive val sharp GT images as inputs (clean protection)
p4dev 896 + r5gap 224 synthetic DEV pairs (other degradation families, larger/smaller faces)
outcome_definition: after BOTH output guards: a blocked output returns ORIGINAL (Δ = 0); 'clearly improved' / 'clearly harmed' = SFace AND dlib Δ > +0.02 / < −0.02 (R5-6 definition); rates over NAFnet attempts

named_bands.E_CLEAN_NOT_BLUR: lapd1_c >= 0.005579 (never admissible in R5-10: clean_lapd1_lo is unchanged)

per_subband_rules (each grid step, archi.R2_benefit: mean ΔSFace bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 AND mean Δdlib > 0
per_subband_rules (each grid step, archi.R3_harm: clearly-harmed rate <= reference rate of the current eligible zone (same mode) + 1.0 pp
per_subband_rules (each grid step, archi.R5_artifacts: global+local guard block rate <= reference block rate (same mode) + 2.0 pp

cumulative_rules (at the candidate bound.R6_clean: share of sharp archive GT faces that pass every other gate and have lapd1_c <= t must be <= 2.0 % (same 2 % convention as clean_lapd1_lo)
cumulative_rules (at the candidate bound.R7_other_degradations: p4dev/r5gap non-blur families newly admitted at t: mean ΔSFace >= 0 and clearly harmed <= clearly improved (descriptive if n < 10)

selection: t* = the largest grid point such that every sub-band from 0.002617 up to t* passes R1-R5 in both modes and R6/R7 hold at t*. Stop at the first failing sub-band (no skipping). If the first sub-band fails: NO CHANGE.
face_size: Report every newly admitted zone by face IOD bucket [35.3,40) [40,45) [45,71.4) [71.4,inf) (35.3 = iod_min, 71.4 = rwgate clean_iod_lo; 40/45 are descriptive splits of the archive range). A size condition is added ONLY if a bucket with >= 100 newly admitted attempts fails R2 or R3; then the newly admitted zone requires IOD >= that bucket's upper edge.
freeze: After DEV selection + regression the config is sealed; TEST / ztest / real-photo / UI results are evaluation only and cannot change it.
